question: Per magazine package of all 67 weapons, read MagazineCapacity and NumberOfMagazines on 2.1.1.0, compute carried totals under readings A and B, list the weapons where capacity is not nominal+1, and propose a Magazine card addition with a validation glance.

summary: M4A1 20 Rnd package WPM_MAG_020Cpt2_556_W05 (control): capacity 21, NumberOfMagazines 10, InitialAmmo -1.
All 67 WB Ammo structs read; capacity equals data/weapons.json mag on 66 weapons; elr40 WB capacity is 1 (N 50), site mag 8.
303 site WEAPON_MAG choices: 302 read (189 from a package Ammo struct, 113 fall back to WB because the shared Std/Fast package has no Ammo struct), 1 unresolved (z84m 100_agil, package not captured).
Capacity minus site nominal: +1 on 277 choices, +0 on 24 (belt LMG magazines, revolvers m44/m357trait, ELR-40 Single Shot), +2 on 1 (DB-12).

All 177 packages and WB structs also present in the L110 1.4.3.0 inventory carry the same capacity, count and InitialAmmo values; 114 of 115 package files have equal raw SHA-256 (62 WB files changed hash, values equal).
Reading A (cap x N) and B (cap x (N+1)) totals per choice are in values.json.

control.description: M4A1 20 Rnd package (WPM_MAG_020Cpt2_556_W05, selector chain from site choice 20_rnd) reads MagazineCapacity 21 and NumberOfMagazines 10 (21 x 10 = 210, the L110 receipt values); data/weapons.json m4a1 mag (31) equals the M4A1_WB MagazineCapacity (31).

sourceFacts.rawChecksFile: a3_rawchecks.json (570 values; every value in values.json and l4068-result.json comes from it)

inference: Capacity nominal+1 on closed-bolt weapons is read as one chambered round (hypothesis); belt LMG and revolver packages are +0, the DB-12 +2.
Packages without an Ammo struct (Std_W05, Fast_W10, MG5_Fast_W10) leave the WB Ammo struct unchanged (inference).
Season 5 site choices are mapped to Attachment_*_MAG_* files by name and nominal count.
unresolved: Site weapon z84m choice 100_agil: selector U_WPM_MAG_100Cpt1_PKM_W05 is captured (Compact1 branch 6919d57e-689a-43cd-bbc8-d88e5f744f59) but its package WPM_MAG_100Cpt1_PKM_W05 is not in the 2.1.1.0 raw tree: needs capture. Capacity and NumberOfMagazines for that choice are unread.

Season 5 site choices (mk24, elr40, z84m, rspr; 16) have no generated-branch row; the mapping from site choice to Attachment_*_MAG_* file is inferred by file name and nominal count (elr40 Compact1 = 1_rnd Single Shot, Compact2 = 5_rnd, Fast = 7_fast, Regular = 7_rnd; z84m Compact1 = 100_agil by exclusion).

Whether NumberOfMagazines includes the loaded magazine (reading A) or counts spare magazines only (reading B), and whether capacity nominal+1 is a chambered round in play, is not decided by the serialized data: needs the in-game glance in proposal.md.
InitialAmmo is -1 on every read package and WB; its meaning remains unresolved (L110 convention).

113 of the 302 resolved site choices use a shared package (WPM_MAG_Std_W05, WPM_MAG_Fast_W10, WPM_MAG_MG5_Fast_W10) that carries no Ammo struct; their capacity and magazine count are the WB values (inference that the package leaves the base ammo struct unchanged).

elr40 WB base MagazineCapacity is 1 with NumberOfMagazines 50 (the Single Shot package reads 1 and 49); site weapons.json elr40 mag is 8, which equals the default 7 Rnd package capacity, not the WB value (the other 66 weapons equal the WB value).
siteImpact: No site number changes now. Proposal: the Magazine card could show "loaded+chambered / reserve" per magazine choice. Outcome A (NumberOfMagazines includes the loaded magazine): M4A1 20 Rnd shows 20+1 / 189 (210 total). Outcome B (reserve only): 20+1 / 210 (231 total). If the chambered reading fails, the card shows capacity as one number with reserve per A or B. weapons.json mag stays at the source capacity.
